answer: Give every identity a random shard of network data to custody, a fragment it must keep like a seed in a meadow. Periodic challenges demand a cryptographic proof the shard is still held, keyed to a fresh on-chain beacon, so proofs cannot be precomputed or shared between copies. Fail one and the bond is slashed, earning rights revoked. A sybil farmer spinning up a thousand identities at dawn must pay for a thousand shards of real disk and bandwidth, and a single reef of failed audits can sink the whole farm.
